Grit long obedience hai.
Himmat jeet ki aatma hai.
Chup rehna woh canvas hai jahan buddhi rang bhar deti hai.
Shak utne sapno ko maarta hai jitna asafalta kabhi nahi maar sakti.
Courage i resistance to fear, mastery of fear—na absence of fear.
Jo humare peeche hai aur jo aage hai, woh humare andar jo hai uske samne bahut chhota hai.
Silence ek great strength ka source hai.
Aag mein bhi shaant rehna himmat hai.
Main fail nahi—bas 10,000 tareeke mile jo nahi kaam kare.
Veer wahi jo sirf darr hi nahi, shak ko bhi paar karta hai.
Shant dimaag ek sharp sword se zyada takatwar hathiyar hai.
Jo kabhi mistake nahi karta—wo kuch naya try hi nahi karta.
Grit na rukne wali drive hai.
Shaant logon ka dimaag sabse shor machata hai.
Hard dinon pe aa jana—grit.
Fear utni hi gehri jitni mind allow kare.
Grit steady commitment hai.
